fig_fang.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium-quality PHOTO-REAL 3D PRODUCT RENDER of a physical 1/7 scale painted PVC anime figurine of FANG (Arknights), one single figurine, upright portrait 1:2 canvas, true transparent background. Reference 1 is ONLY character identity and exact costume/colors. Reference 2 is ONLY framing, sculpted pedestal thickness, upper-left light direction and product camera; DO NOT copy its placeholder character or chibi proportions.
This must unmistakably look like a REAL SOLID MINIATURE SCULPTURE photographed in a studio: rounded sculpted face with painted anime eyes, real three-dimensional nose and cheeks, visible thickness to bangs and separate flowing hair locks, cast occlusion shadows under hair and collar, thick coat hems and sculpted folds, physical seams on PVC boots, soft broad specular highlights on molded plastic, reflected edge light on hair and cloth, realistic soft volumetric shading, no flat black outlines. Clearly visible side surfaces on torso, arms, legs and clothing, not a printed cardboard cutout. NO illustration, NO cel shading, NO painterly brushwork. Character face remains faithful stylized anime, not a human actor.
Character: blue-gray tied hair and long blue horse tail, tall pointed horse ears, blue eyes, black long Rhodes Island open jacket with gray sleeves and teal short dress, black thigh-high socks, brown boots, long black spear with metallic silver spearhead. Same identity as reference, normal approximately seven-head human proportions (NOT CHIBI). Relaxed balanced standing pose with weight on back leg; spear held diagonally but close to body so its FULL TIP and entire shaft stay inside the tall canvas. Costume colors and identity unchanged.
Green rarity PRIZE EDITION: simple round dark gray physically thick display base with two small gray stones, no elaborate scene/effects. Boots visibly CONTACT pedestal; small natural contact shadows on the pedestal itself.
CONSISTENT SERIES CAMERA: 3/4 front view with about 25-degree yaw, camera gently looking downward about 8 degrees. Full body and full base in frame. Base elliptical top surface visibly foreshortened, base centered near bottom, ample safe margins all sides, object roughly 86% of canvas height and 75% width. Key large softbox at upper-left-front, modest thin rim light at rear right. Crisp high-resolution commercial scale figure product photography, neutral color rendering, rich soft local shading.
BACKGROUND must be genuinely FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including all space between limbs and spear; no studio wall, no gradient, no floor, no external drop shadow, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard texture. Only the figurine and its attached pedestal. No text, no watermark, no frame.
fig_fang.repair_prompt: Edit this exact 3D PVC FANG scale figurine product render. Preserve the solid sculptural 3D realism, face identity, blue hair, costume, pose, boots, and simple round base. Reframe by zooming OUT and repositioning the long spear closer to upright beside the body, so the COMPLETE spear tip and shaft, both horse ears, all hair and the full base are completely visible with at least 8% clear transparent margin on ALL sides. Do not crop any object. Keep normal seven-head proportions. Maintain the same three-quarter product camera and physical volume. Clean the silhouette: remove any blue/chroma-key fringing and stray detached pixels outside the figurine, use a thin neutral white edge highlight, not an electric blue halo. Background must be TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including all holes between limbs and weapons. No floor, backdrop, graphic, frame, text or external shadow. This is a dimensional real PVC figure, not an illustration; preserve existing 3D surface and material finish. One figure and one base only.

fig_kroos.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset: single finished 1/7 scale Arknights painted PVC figurine product photograph, portrait 1:2, true transparent background. IMAGE 1 supplies ONLY exact character identity, costume, colors and recognizable species/weapon details. IMAGE 2 supplies ONLY the photoreal SOLID 3D FIGURINE MATERIAL, studio light, lens, camera, physical round pedestal and rendering quality. Do not copy image 2's character, ears or outfit. If a third reference is present, it supplies ONLY the small Mon3tr creature design.
Create a REAL SOLID SCULPTURE photographed commercially, with clearly rounded volumes and depth. Sculpted anime face with real projecting nose/chin/cheeks and painted anime eyes, NOT a real human actor. Normal roughly SEVEN-HEAD human proportions, never chibi. Hair is thick tapered physical locks with separation and occlusion shadows, cloth has substantial edges and deep sculpted folds, arms torso and boots show rounded side surfaces and physical thickness. Soft broad realistic PVC specular highlights, semi-matte skin, mildly satin painted costume and hair, realistic occlusion shadows under bangs/collars and boots. Detailed sculptural seams and material edges. No thick black drawn contours, no cel-shaded areas, no flat illustration, no painted concept-art brushstrokes, no cardboard standee or printed acrylic panel.
SERIES CAMERA: rotate the figure about 25 degrees from frontal to show a clear THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, gently looking down about 8 degrees; keep face readable. Upper-left-front large softbox key light with soft shadows and a thin neutral WHITE rear-right rim light. Neutral true costume colors; no colored outline, no blue fringe. Full-body INCLUDING ENTIRE WEAPONS, hair, ears/horns, and COMPLETE PEDESTAL, with 8% clear space at EVERY image edge. Zoom out enough; never crop any tip or sword. Keep long weapons angled close to upright beside body to fit narrow frame. Body and attached base should occupy approximately 85% canvas height and no more than 82% width. The round base has visible ellipse top and deep physical sidewall; boot soles visibly contact its surface. Figure is balanced as a commercially manufactured collectible, minimal discreet support if needed.
Only ONE character sculpture on ONE attached theme pedestal. No image labels, no names, no game rarity border or external effects. Transparent ALPHA around the complete model and inside openings, no studio wall, no floor plane, no external drop shadow, no background gradient or checkerboard image. Effects if specified are physically molded translucent plastic attached to pedestal or figure, not painted floating graphic glow. CHARACTER fig_kroos: Honey orange hair in short twin braids, tall orange rabbit ears, closed smiling eyes. Dark oversized black-brown jacket over green shirt, short black shorts with red trim, green sneakers with pale socks. Hold the black crossbow upright angled close to body, all bow tips visible. THEME PEDESTAL AND FINISH: Simple prize-edition dark gray thick circular base, one small paving stone, no big effects. Rarity green affects pedestal luxury and paint precision, not background. Preserve approved character identity, E0 outfit and silhouette.
